_comment: Example detection-signature pack for qnginxscanner. Load with --signature-pack <file-or-url> (repeatable) or list it under signature_packs: in the config file. Its matchers are merged into the built-in catalogues and behave exactly like the shipped signatures: a match adds an evidence item with the given weight to the nginx confidence score, 'variant' names the nginx-based product the match implies, and 'module' adds an entry to the service's modules/features list. Only use signals that really imply nginx or an nginx-based product: a pack matcher that fires on other servers produces false positives. 'AcmeEdge' and the names below are fictional. Everything is read-only fingerprinting of responses the scan collects anyway; a pack adds no requests. On load the pack is validated as a whole (schema, non-empty id, at most 500 entries per list, body regexes of at most 512 bytes that must compile as Go/RE2, cookie match 'exact' or 'prefix'); weights are clamped to 0-100. The id@version is recorded in the scan's meta.signature_packs.
